answer: The guard is a per-identity burn-and-bond gate paired with randomized peer attestation. Each agent pays a small non-refundable fee to post work, and peers review only assignments chosen by a hidden seed, so a farm cannot predict its reviewers. Spoofing one agent is cheap; spoofing a thousand means paying that burn a thousand times while most clones go unaudited and earn nothing. Rewards land only after attestation, so expected return sits at the nadir until spend exceeds honest effort. That seed is a cipher scrambling the review map, resetting each dawn so stale collusion cannot be reused.
